rounds.q: How many years did the oldest person ever live?
rounds.why: Jeanne Calment of France lived 122 years and 164 days, and took up fencing at 85.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Oldest person ever (record set 1997, still standing 2026)
rounds.fun: 122 years, and she picked up a fencing sword at 85. Never too late!

rounds.q: How fast did the fastest train on record go, in miles per hour?
rounds.why: A Japanese maglev train, which floats on magnets, hit 374.68 mph on a test track in 2015.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Fastest maglev train (record set 2015)
rounds.fun: 375 mph while floating on magnets. Blink and you miss the whole train!

rounds.q: How tall was the tallest person ever, in inches?
rounds.why: Robert Wadlow stood 8 feet 11.1 inches in 1940 and wore size 37 shoes.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Tallest man ever (measured 1940)
rounds.fun: 8 feet 11 in size 37 shoes. Robert Wadlow never lost anyone in a crowd.

rounds.q: How many miles long is the world's longest bridge?
rounds.why: China's Danyang-Kunshan Grand Bridge opened in 2011 and carries high-speed trains.
rounds.fun: 102 miles of bridge, built for high-speed trains. Hold on to your hat!

rounds.q: How many feet deep is the world's deepest lake?
rounds.why: Lake Baikal in Russia is over a mile deep and 395 miles long from end to end.
rounds.fun: 5,387 feet down. Lake Baikal is more than a mile deep. Bring a long rope!
